D01.text: So. The angel sent me another promising little soul. Choose Enter on that frost door. I’ve found you something suitably unimpressive to fight.
D01.speaker: demon

A02.text: See those crystals? With Farm Near on, your pets will mine beside you. Help them along, and we’ll soon have coins for another friend.
A02.speaker: angel

A03.text: You’ve earned another egg. Shall we see who’s waiting inside? Every new friend gives your little squad more strength.
A03.speaker: angel

A04.text: I’ve left a Rainbow Kitty in your inventory. Open Pets, and let’s make room for that bright little spark on your squad.
A04.speaker: angel

A05.text: There’s a gift within you, too. It’s called Resonance. Open Edit on your power bar, and give it a place where you can reach it.
A05.speaker: angel

A06.text: Now, try Resonance near the crystals. Feel that? Your power helps them break faster and yield a little more.
A06.speaker: angel

A07.text: A little Potency will make that gift stronger. Open Powers, and let’s add your new enhancement to Resonance.
A07.speaker: angel

A08.text: The Earth cave is a place to practice fighting. Follow the trail when you’re ready. Its instructor has rather more horns than patience.
A08.speaker: angel

A09.text: A good leader knows when to call everyone home. Try Rally—the flag on your power bar—and bring your pets back to your side.
A09.speaker: angel

A10.text: Look how far you’ve come. The Ascension Altar is ready for you. Choose your next power, then follow your missions. There’s a whole world waiting.
A10.speaker: angel

D02.text: There’s your opponent. Get close and let your pets do the fighting. Yes, they do most of the work. Try to look involved.
D02.speaker: demon

D03.text: One training dog defeated. Terrifying. The glowing pillar takes you back to the lobby. We’ll see if that was luck.
D03.speaker: demon

D04.text: Berserk Brew. A little borrowed ferocity for your pets. Take a sip from your power bar. This is the safe room, after all.
D04.speaker: demon

D05.text: Feeling fierce? Enter the arena. Let’s find out whether your pets agree.
D05.speaker: demon

D06.text: Notice the harder hits? That’s the brew. Finish this one before you start taking all the credit.
D06.speaker: demon

D07.text: Better. The pillar will bring you back. Next, we address your squad’s regrettable habit of getting hurt.
D07.speaker: demon

D08.text: You have Heal. How inconvenient for me. Open Edit, put it on your power bar, and finish with Done.
D08.speaker: demon

D09.text: Let’s make Heal worth using. Open Powers and give it the Healing enhancement I provided. I prefer my opponents properly prepared.
D09.speaker: demon

D10.text: Your healing lesson awaits. Enter the arena—and do pay attention to your pets this time.
D10.speaker: demon

D11.text: That yellow health bar belongs to your wounded pet. Select its card. Admiring the problem won’t mend it.
D11.speaker: demon

D12.text: Now use Heal on the pet you selected. Once it recovers, those enemy shields come down. Consider that your warning.
D12.speaker: demon

D13.text: Shields down. Finish both training dogs. The exit pillar is for winners, little hero.
D13.speaker: demon

D14.text: The room is clear. Use the glowing pillar to finish Basic Training. You’ve become slightly less likely to embarrass yourself.
D14.speaker: demon

D15.text: Back for more? How irritatingly diligent. I’ve given you Weakening Vials. Enter the arena, and we’ll spoil someone’s defenses.
D15.speaker: demon

D16.text: Choose the marked enemy’s card. The vial needs a target. Throwing it at your own feet would make a very short lesson.
D16.speaker: demon

D17.text: Throw the Weakening Vial at your target. Down come the shields. Then you can get on with the unpleasant business of winning.
D17.speaker: demon

D18.text: Their shields are gone. Defeat both dogs. No, the pillar won’t rescue you from unfinished work.
D18.speaker: demon

D19.text: You found a weakness and used it. Almost devious. Take the pillar back to the lobby.
D19.speaker: demon

D20.text: More Berserk Brew means bigger hits, not a longer timer. Drink five sips. We’re building a damage meter, not a collection.
D20.speaker: demon

D21.text: There. A proper dose of trouble. Enter the arena while that damage meter has something left to give.
D21.speaker: demon

D22.text: Now watch those hits. Much more convincing. Finish the dog before your borrowed courage wears off.
D22.speaker: demon

D23.text: That was almost efficient. The glowing pillar finishes this course. I suppose you’ll want your reward.
D23.speaker: demon

D24.text: Let’s put something sturdier between your squad and disaster. Open Pets. One doggy is making room for a bear.
D24.speaker: demon

D25.text: The tank draws attention and takes the punishment. It hits less hard, but your other pets get to keep their dignity—and their health. Finish the fight.
D25.speaker: demon

D26.text: Still standing. How tiresome. Take the pillar back; your next opponents have learned a little trick.
D26.speaker: demon

D27.text: The next pack brought a healer. Leave it alone and it will keep repairing your hard work. Enter when you’ve grasped the problem.
D27.speaker: demon

D28.text: That green healing mark is your clue. Send your pets after the healer first. I’d rather you didn’t, which should tell you everything.
D28.speaker: demon

D29.text: Healer down. Now finish the rest of the pack. They’re suddenly much less optimistic.
D29.speaker: demon

D30.text: There. No one left to patch them up. Back through the pillar. One last room, and I stop holding your hand.
D30.speaker: demon

D31.text: Final room. Two dogs, one healer, and no helpful arrows. You have the tools. Enter when you’re ready to make me regret teaching you.
D31.speaker: demon

D32.text: All yours, little hero. Clear the room. Let’s see what you remember when I stop telling you.
D32.speaker: demon

D33.text: No arrows, and you still managed it. Deeply inconvenient. Take the glowing pillar and finish your training.
D33.speaker: demon

D34.text: Basic Training, complete. Your pets and powers are ready for the world. Advanced lessons are optional. I’m sure you’ll miss my encouragement.
D34.speaker: demon

D35.text: Advanced One, complete. You’ve earned a Double XP token. Use it from your inventory when you want the extra experience. Do try to make it count.
D35.speaker: demon

D36.text: All courses complete. There’s a Double Coins token waiting in your inventory. Use it when you’re ready. You’ve become a rather troublesome little hero.
D36.speaker: demon

A11.text: Your active squad is full. Let one pet rest in your inventory, and we can welcome the Kitty.
A11.speaker: angel

A12.text: There’s your Rainbow Kitty. Choose that little one for the open place on your squad.
A12.speaker: angel

A13.text: They’re ready. Choose Activate, and your new squad will join you.
A13.speaker: angel

A14.text: Choose Resonance and an open place on your power bar. Put it wherever feels right to you.
A14.speaker: angel

A15.text: There it is. Choose Done to finish setting your power bar.
A15.speaker: angel

A16.text: Choose Resonance. That’s the power we’re making stronger.
A16.speaker: angel

A17.text: An empty enhancement slot is a little room to grow. Choose one on Resonance.
A17.speaker: angel

A18.text: Choose Potency. It gives your crystal-boosting pulse a little more strength.
A18.speaker: angel

A19.text: Choose Apply, and that extra strength becomes yours.
A19.speaker: angel

A20.text: Try a small crystal nearby. Keep Farm Near on, and let your squad earn the coins together.
A20.speaker: angel

A21.text: Bring your squad close to the crystals before you use Resonance. That’s where its gift can help.
A21.speaker: angel

D37.text: Choose Heal, then give it a place on your power bar. Ideally somewhere you’ll remember when things start biting.
D37.speaker: demon

D38.text: Now choose Done. You can admire your arrangement after you survive.
D38.speaker: demon

D39.text: Choose Heal. We’re improving that power, not browsing for something prettier.
D39.speaker: demon

D40.text: Choose an empty slot on Heal. Even your good intentions need somewhere to go.
D40.speaker: demon

D41.text: Choose Healing. The name is a subtle clue.
D41.speaker: demon

D42.text: Apply it. A staged enhancement is doing precisely nothing for you.
D42.speaker: demon

D43.text: Take a doggy off your active squad. The bear needs a place, not an invitation to an already full party.
D43.speaker: demon

D44.text: Choose your strongest bear. The Tank option in Best Pets can find it for you, if counting muscles proves difficult.
D44.speaker: demon

D45.text: Choose Activate. I need the bear in the fight, not posing in your inventory.
D45.speaker: demon

D46.text: The bear is on your squad. Close Pets so we can get on with it.
D46.speaker: demon

D47.text: Your tank is ready. Enter the arena and let it earn its place.
D47.speaker: demon

A22.text: Of course. Training will be waiting in Quest whenever you’re ready. You can return to the Earth cave then.
A22.speaker: angel

A23.text: Welcome back, little light. We’ll carry on from where you left off. Follow your current lesson when you’re ready.
A23.speaker: angel

A24.text: Welcome back. I hope he remembered his manners. You’ve learned to look after your squad—and that matters far more than looking fearless.
A24.speaker: angel

D48.text: Basic first. Then, if you insist on improving, two advanced courses await. Choose your lesson, little hero.
D48.speaker: demon

D49.text: Finish the earlier course first. Skipping the lesson is not the same as mastering it.
D49.speaker: demon

D50.text: A repeat performance? Very well. The practice is yours; the first-time reward stays first-time.
D50.speaker: demon

D51.text: Finished again. No second reward, of course. Surely my company was compensation enough.
D51.speaker: demon

D52.text: Leaving already? Your progress is saved. Come back when you’re ready to disappoint me properly.
D52.speaker: demon

D53.text: Back, are you? Your completed lessons still count. We’ll prepare this round again before you enter.
D53.speaker: demon

D54.text: Bring at least one pet. This is combat training, not an audition for the role of bait.
D54.speaker: demon

D55.text: Choose Done on your power bar first. I prefer my opponents assembled before the fight.
D55.speaker: demon

D56.text: Heal belongs on your power bar. Put it there before asking that door to open.
D56.speaker: demon

D57.text: Add Healing to Heal and apply it. Then we can discuss opening the door.
D57.speaker: demon

D58.text: The Berserk Brew is for drinking. One sip, little hero. Then you may enter.
D58.speaker: demon

D59.text: A bear on your active squad, please. Owning a tank is not the same as bringing one.
D59.speaker: demon

D60.text: Four more sips. That meter isn’t filling itself.
D60.speaker: demon

D61.text: Three more. I admire your commitment to doing this slowly.
D61.speaker: demon

D62.text: Two more sips. Even I can see you’re nearly there.
D62.speaker: demon

D63.text: One more. Let’s not lose our nerve at the finish.
D63.speaker: demon

D64.text: Your pets have wandered off the healer. Select it again. We were so close to having a strategy.
D64.speaker: demon

A25.text: There you are, little light. Let’s choose your first companion. A bunny, a bear, a doggy, or a kitty — who will join you on your adventure?
A25.speaker: angel

A01.text: Your companion could use a friend. Follow the trail to the Earth Egg, and let’s wake one.
A01.speaker: angel
